limits: K12 linear release sensitivity on accepted timber mesh, not insert/wide geometry. Fixed XYZ floor, no gravity; ideal rim bond, common N=0 edge and bonded leg plies retained. Three basis solves and one linear scenario combination; point stresses unqualified.
